chars.MOM: MOM: a Moroccan middle-aged mother wearing a dark green kaftan with gold trim and a beige headscarf tied under the chin.
chars.BRIDE: BRIDE: a young woman wearing a soft pink long dress with a white cardigan and a light pink headscarf, neat and elegant.
chars.SON: SON: a man of about 30 wearing a navy zip work jacket with orange reflective stripes and grey cargo trousers.
chars.SIS: SIS: a teenage girl wearing a yellow hoodie and blue jeans.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from the doorway of a traditional Moroccan salon in Fes with low sofas and a brass tea tray: the BRIDE politely serves tea with a gentle smile while MOM, seated, leans back and narrows her eyes at her with open suspicion. Head-to-waist framing, both faces clearly visible, slightly comic tension.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: MOM, SON and SIS step through the front door into a decorated Moroccan family salon carrying a box of sweets and a sugar cone, visiting to ask for a bride's hand, excited and a bit nervous.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: The BRIDE walks gracefully carrying a silver teapot, eyes lowered, very polite and calm, while SON on the sofa stares at her amazed and smiling, in a Moroccan salon.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Night, inside a small old car parked on a Moroccan street: MOM in the passenger seat whispers with a suspicious frown and a raised finger, SON at the wheel looks at her confused.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: In a modest Moroccan kitchen MOM explains dramatically, counting on her fingers with a knowing look, while SON leans on the counter rolling his eyes, comic mood.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: MOM's imagination, shown as a dreamy scene with a soft cloudy vignette: the BRIDE angrily shouting with hands on hips in a Moroccan living room while a small worried MOM shrinks back on the sofa, comic exaggeration.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: The BRIDE arrives at the narrow front door of a modest Moroccan family house in a popular neighbourhood, pulling a suitcase and smiling, SON carrying a second bag behind her, while MOM watches from the doorway with arms crossed and a doubtful look.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: In the family salon the BRIDE hands MOM a big wrapped gift box from her family, smiling kindly, while MOM accepts it with a surprised, still slightly suspicious face; plates of Moroccan cookies on a low table.
